localChanges: When you start a Civilization II game, New Game and Customise now offer Civilization II's own world sizes, Small (40 × 50), Normal (50 × 80) and Large (75 × 120), each with 3 to 7 civilizations, as the original does (closes #1175).
A world size you type in for a Civilization II game must be from 20 to 250 squares each way and from 1,000 to 10,000 squares in all, and Customise says so when it isn't.
